description:
List a wallet's largest open positions by current value.

    Accepts a 0x wallet address or an OrcaLayer nickname. Returns the
    positions with the largest current value first, in a compact form, plus a
    count of how many more are not shown.

address.description: 0x wallet address (proxy or signer) or OrcaLayer nickname.
address.title: Address

limit.description: How many open positions to return, 1 to 50. The wallet may hold more; the response reports how many were left out.
limit.title: Limit

name: wallet_positions
title: Wallet open positions
